<entry id="H01328">
<head-word>חַס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (חוּס) 
<italic>sparing, forbearance</italic>, only (adverbial) חַס וְשָׁלוֹם 
<italic>forbearance and peace!, God forfend!, don’t say that!</italic></definition>
<notes> Eduy. V, 6 ח' וש' שעקביא וכ' God forbid (to think) that ʿAkabia was excommunicated! Sabb. 138
<sup>b</sup> ח' וש' שתשתכח וכ' God forbid (to entertain the idea) that the Law will be forgotten &c. B. Mets. 85
<sup>b</sup> ח' וש' אי וכ' if, which God forfend, the Law should be forgotten &c.—Y. Pes. VI, 33
<sup>a</sup> bot. (in Chald. phraseology) ח' וש' דהוה בעי לה God forbid (to think) that he would have done it!; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>
<definition> ; 
<italic>Pi</italic>.</definition>
<notes> חִסֵּד, חִשֵּׂד [
<italic>to scrape off</italic>,] (cmp. גדף, גרף) 
<italic>to jeer, scoff at, to shame</italic>. Ruth R. to IV, 8 שחִסְּדָן ברבים (or שחֲסָדָן; ed. Wil. שחשדן) he scoffed at them publicly (speaking ironically, with ref. to II Chr. XIII, 8); Y. Yeb. XVII, beg. 15
<sup>c</sup> שחִישֵּׂד וכ' he jeered at Jeroboam; Gen. R. s. 65; ib. s. 73 שחסדם ed. Wil. (oth. שחש'); Lev. R. s. 33; Midr. Sam. ch. XVIII שחִיסְּדָן; Yalk. Kings 205 ומְחַשֵּׂד.—Ex. R. s. 30 (ref. to Ex. II, 14) שחִיסְּדוּ וכ' when Dathan and Abiram sneered at him. Ib. בזה שחִיסַּדְתֶּם אותו וכ' with the very word (שופט) with which you sneered at him, I shall give him the rulership (משפטים). Pesik. R. s. 42 מְחַסְּדִים את שרה (not מחסרו') jeered at Sarah; a. e.—V. חִיסּוּד.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01337">
<head-word>חֶסֶד</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="H01336"> חָסַד I)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>grace, kindness, love, charity</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra K’dosh., Par. 4, ch. X (ref. to חסד, Lev. XX, 17) שמא תאמר … ח' הוא if you will object, why did Cain marry his sister? (Answ.) It was an act of kindness (to secure the propagation of the race); Y. Yeb. XI, 11
<sup>d</sup> top ח' עשיתי וכ' I (the Lord) dealt kindly with &c.—חוט של ח', v. חוּט. Succ. 49
<sup>b</sup> אין צדקה … לפי ח' שבה charity is rewarded only in proportion to the benevolence in it. Ib. תורה של ח' a study of love (for its own sake); a. fr.—Ruth R. Par. 3, beg., v. חִסְדָּאָה.—Gen. R. s. 8 ח' אומר Charity said &c.—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲסָדִים</plural-form>
<italic>acts of kindness</italic>. Succ. l. c.; a. fr.; v. גָּמַל a. גְּמִילוּת.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
